summary: Provides factory functions and interface extensions for creating a mock CLI runtime in test suites.
responsibilities: Define MemoryRuntime interface extending CliRuntime with output capturing methods.
Implement createMemoryRuntime to generate a mock runtime with in-memory streams.
Provide a CaptureStream class for buffering and retrieving stream output during unit tests.
